ordinal_dispositions.summary: FeedEngine introduced bounded topic selection, tiny feedback-trained ranker, source/recency/anti-clickbait features and diversity mixing without LLM calls; demonstrates cheap learned ranking as a derived preference layer, not truth.

SOMA timer activation, snapshot cap 14->3 and removal of autonomous nightly news cycle separate adaptation scheduling/resource policy from information capability; on-demand replaced autonomous collection.

Intelligence V6 moved to query-driven source collection with full-page fetch, entity/story graph, relevance threshold/drift guards, claim dedup and coherence validation. Valuable retrieval/provenance counterexamples; synthesis remains derived evidence.

Large v7 transition removed legacy art/stickers, introduced native_vision/news_intel and changed model/subsystem surfaces. Historical architecture transitions must be version-bound; removed mechanisms carry lineage but no current authority.

SOMA rebuild migrated base model, reduced memory via bfloat16, fixed lifecycle/restart conflicts, persisted cycle identity and feedback windows, weighted explicit feedback, and exposed live training state. Strong adaptive-candidate lifecycle evidence.

Personality radar/change log and feedback aggregates expose learned-state deltas to user. Visualization is projection of measured adaptation and must retain cycle/version provenance rather than become authoritative personality truth.

Final SOMA audit fixed thread lifecycle, singleton races, bounded/atomic config writes, interaction dedup, two-sided adapter-key drift, near-zero similarity semantics, model-mode restoration and midnight windows. Defines fail-closed adaptation/recovery invariants.

Stale import-time config, concurrent training corruption, falsey override semantics and restart-flag TOCTOU were fixed with live config reads, single-cycle lock, explicit None semantics and atomic rename. Runtime adaptation controls require epochs/atomicity/idempotence.

Deep audit found schema-field mismatch, DB/resource leaks, EMA key loss, error-path model leaks, toggle ghost threads, substring-metric false positives and zero-norm drift false-safe behavior. Candidate safety requires structural compatibility plus defined edge-case metrics.

Introduced fixed before/after adaptation probes and six heuristic personality dimensions with stored cycle changelog. Useful paired-measurement pattern, but lexical heuristics were later shown to have false-positive/default-bias defects and are not ground truth.

Expanded LoRA target surface, added conversion fallback chain and conservative first-cycle warmup because no previous EMA partner exists. Cold-start adaptation needs separate policy and deploy-format fallback must not invalidate the source candidate.

Explicit thumbs feedback was bound to the prompting user message and weighted above proxy engagement heuristics; training targets broadened. Direct user evidence and inferred quality must remain separately provenance-tagged.

Installer reconciled removed services/models, single-model architecture, optional GPU capability, SOMA training model and bridge services. Install manifests must derive from current capability graph rather than stale architecture names.

SOMA training dependencies plus opt-in systemd oneshot/timer encoded TimeoutStartSec, MemoryMax, Nice and CPUQuota. Learning duty cycle/resource budgets are explicit runtime policy, not hidden model behavior.

Original SOMA pipeline established interaction scoring -> bounded training -> safety checks -> snapshot/EMA -> conversion/deploy -> rollback/hot reload with opt-in control. This is a direct historical precursor pattern for bounded user-specific adaptive learning.

Titan->LCME migration preserved DB/tool compatibility while retrieval quality fixes removed noisy entity vectors, added FTS stopwords/HNSW, disabled graph expansion and gated neural retrieval until mature. Compatibility identity and cold-start fallback are first-class.

Hippocampus neural retrieval plus 36 fixes exposed cache hot-path latency, thread/dedup/training defects, reward variation, stale hypothesis decay, visual OCR cleanup and tool/output boundaries. Mature learned retrieval must remain replaceable by deterministic fallback.
PTT control rendering moved after page DOM construction and chat alignment changed; UI lifecycle fix only, no independent current semantic credit.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Historical SOMA separated training candidate, fixed probes/safety checks, snapshot, promotion/reload and rollback. Multiple audits showed concurrency/resource/edge-case failures when these boundaries were weak.
distilled_invariants.validation: Adaptive learner candidate trains in shadow, receives held-out/open-set/forgetting/resource checks, atomically promotes only on PASS, and last-known-good rollback restores exact version after injected failure.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Neural retrieval was disabled until sufficient training maturity; first SOMA cycle used reduced steps/LR because no EMA predecessor existed.
distilled_invariants.validation: Versioned learner state exposes cold/warming/mature; deterministic baseline owns decisions before maturity and remains rescue path after learned-component failure.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Thumb feedback was historically weighted above inferred engagement/depth; heuristic metrics later exhibited false positives and default bias.
distilled_invariants.validation: Training-example ledger records source/tier/weight; GOLD explicit labels cannot be silently synthesized from click/engagement/proxy scores; ablation reports behavior with proxy signals removed.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Import-time frozen config, concurrent cycles and restart-flag TOCTOU caused stale/corrupt behavior; fixes used live reads, locks and atomic rename/write.
distilled_invariants.validation: Concurrent force/scheduled update admits exactly one candidate cycle; config epoch used by a cycle is receipted; crash between write/rename/reload yields old-or-new valid state, never partial hybrid.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: EMA blending once dropped keys existing only on the new side; adapter config metadata could desynchronize from weights. LCME migration deliberately preserved DB/tool identities for compatibility.
distilled_invariants.validation: Promotion verifies complete parameter/feature/schema key set and feature-backbone/version compatibility; migration preserves or explicitly transforms persisted identity with receipt.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: Near-zero baseline drift was once reported as zero and therefore falsely safe; lexical personality probes also produced substring false positives.
distilled_invariants.validation: NaN/Inf/zero-norm/empty-class/unknown-label cases have explicit semantics and cannot auto-PASS candidate safety; metric implementation is tested against adversarial fixtures.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: SOMA used opt-in timers, RAM checks, memory/CPU quotas and lifecycle coordination; autonomous news collection was later removed in favor of on-demand search.
distilled_invariants.validation: Over-budget learning pauses without disabling perception; schedule/owner-presence policies are observable and cannot be overridden by classifier/model output.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: LCME/Hippocampus and FeedRanker learned/ranked candidate selection while deterministic stores/sources remained underneath; graph expansion was disabled after retrieval quality regressions.
distilled_invariants.validation: Selection output retains source IDs/scores/version; deterministic fallback can reproduce source access; learned ranker lesions cannot erase stored evidence or rewrite provenance.

distilled_invariants.mechanism: v7 removed Ollama/AURA/legacy services while native vision/single-model/SOMA surfaces changed rapidly; stale installation/docs were repeatedly corrected.
distilled_invariants.validation: Build/install/harness manifest is generated/validated against executable module/service identities and versions; stale named capability causes explicit mismatch, not silent install/runtime drift.

adaptive_visual_learning_transfer.mapping: SOMA candidate/safety/promotion/rollback, cold-start gating, feedback provenance, resource budgets, version compatibility and live-config concurrency provide historical failure-tested lifecycle patterns for the mandatory Micro Visual Classifier. Visual learner semantics remain separately defined by current Retina directive; SOMA LoRA weights/data are not imported as visual truth.

negative_results.result: Adaptation control using bare booleans/unlocked lifecycle and weak edge-case metrics produced race and false-safety bugs.
WebUI persisted config did not affect running code because imported constants were stale; simultaneous forced/background training could corrupt one shared output.
EMA over only old keys silently discarded new adapter keys; zero-norm drift could falsely report safe; shutdown left ghost threads.
Initial lexical personality probe used substring matching and neutral defaults that biased measurements; later audit corrected both.
Unmature neural retrieval and graph expansion hurt recall; learned layers required cold-start gates/kill switches and deterministic fallback.

earned_work.reason: SOMA/LCME/Hippocampus lineages already have HEW-PF-SOMA-007 and HEW-PF-LCME-006 families and a dedicated reconciliation peer is active. This shard adds sharper failure-tested contracts without duplicate hours.
